parts:
Good evening
I would like to have the interpretation of my results?Could you help me with my cases.
My research consists of a relationship between quality of service (QUAL) and satisfaction (SAT) on the one hand and a relation between satisfaction (SAT) and fidelity (FID) on the other.
In Qual, there are variables Q1, Q2 ... to Q20, and in SAT we find S1, and for fidelity there are variables F1, F2, ... to F5.
thank you

+ # latent variable definition

+ QUAL =~ Q1+Q2+Q4+Q5+Q6+Q19+Q20+Q3+Q7+Q8+Q10+Q11+Q12+Q13+Q14+Q15+Q16+Q9+Q18

+ SAT =~ S1

+ FID =~ F1+F2+F3+F4+F5

+ # regressions

parts: These results and the syntax don't match. In particular, your results include:

Regressions:

                   Estimate  Std.Err  z-value  P(>|z|)

  QUAL ~                                             

    SAT               0.688    0.180    3.828    0.000

  SAT ~                                              

    FID               0.224       NA                 

 

Covariances:

                   Estimate  Std.Err  z-value  P(>|z|)

 .QUAL ~~                                            

   .SAT              -0.215    0.078   -2.752    0.006

 .SAT ~~                                             

    FID               0.135       NA

Your syntax says nothing about residual covariances between Qual and Sat and between Sat and Fid. Also, your degrees of freedom do not match my expectations for your syntax.

     It is pointless to evaluate fit until you are estimating the correct model. However, it would be naive to expect a model with 19 indicators for one factor to fit well, and all fit information here points to a poor fit, with the evidence muted by your low sample size of 100.
